static_traits.name: Wang Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has friends and family to talk about Average matters with, but has not yet discussed hiking-related Anxiety and worries with them
static_traits.medical_history: Deny prior similar psychological problems; has not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, logically coherent, capable of self-Reflection and reality testing; cooperative attitude, calm tone; moderate Anxiety and Self-doubt, occasionally seeking reassurance from others

basic_info.main_problem: Worrying that others will think of me as a 'lonely person' because I hike alone, causing Anxiety and Self-doubt that affect enjoyment of hiking and socializing.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to reduce the Fear of others' evaluations, regain enjoyment of solo hiking, and lower Self-doubt in social situations.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on the views of others and recognition
Doing things alone is easily seen as 'not accepted / having no friends', which will get me Being rejected

special_situations.event: Overhearing others at the trailhead talking about 'solo hikers are mostly very lonely'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I hike alone, others will conclude I am a lonely, unsociable person, which means something is wrong with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to rationalize, seek comfort and recognition from friends, or avoid going out alone to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will surely think I am a loner

special_situations.event: When planning a solo hiking trip
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others think of me as a 'lonely person', it proves I have no friends and am not accepted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated thinking and self-persuasion, shortening itineraries or canceling plans to lower risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time everyone will surely look at me strangely

special_situations.event: When talking with others about one's hiking hobby
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Talking about my solo hiking will make others label me negatively, affecting my image among people
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussion, downplaying one's hobby, shifting topics, and seeking the other person's approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am unsociable and nobody wants me

special_situations.event: Recalls interactions with others during hiking (mostly friendly)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative cues are more reliable, positive experiences do not count, and one must stay vigilant about others' potential negative evaluations
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Selectively focusing on negative remarks, ignoring positive interactions to 'protect oneself' from being hurt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That time others praised me was just a fluke; more people actually look down on solo hikers

core_conflict.wish: Wanting to keep independence and Freedom, while also longing to be accepted and recognized by others
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being labeled 'lonely / unsociable' for acting alone, thus being belittled or excluded
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety when being evaluated through Intellectualization and Rationalization
Avoids potential rejection by avoiding talking or reducing going out alone
Maintains self-worth briefly by seeking reassurance from others

object_relations.self_representation: A loner who may be looked down on and needs others' recognition
A capable, appreciated hiker and knowledge provider
object_relations.object_representation: Friendly, respectful others willing to interact

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites examining the evidence or analyzing 'whether others are judging'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling the need to control the situation through rational analysis to avoid feeling ashamed or being negated again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an analytical tone, emphasizing logic and evidence, downplaying personal feelings and emotional experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to affirm positive interactions or record positive experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing positive evidence is not enough to guarantee safety, worrying that letting one's guard down will invite judgment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing advance anticipation of future negative scenarios in a cautious tone, emphasizing the need to 'be prepared'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing 'whether solo hiking means not being accepted' and it touches on self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning potential external negation into self-criticism to avoid direct conflict with others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (such as 'maybe I am not sociable enough'), reducing expressions of dissatisfaction with others, in a restrained tone.

manifestations: Loving solo hiking but worrying about being labeled 'lonely / unsociable'
Repeatedly second-guessing others' opinions after social interactions, experiencing Self-doubt
Shaken in affirming one's own choices by others' comments (such as 'solo hikers are very lonely')
outcomes: Declining interest and motivation in hiking, avoidance emerging
Feeling awkward when talking about the hobby with others, Relationship tension

manifestations: Valuing independent and free choices (solo hiking)
Limiting free expression and action out of fear of others' evaluations (fewer solo outings, avoiding discussion)
outcomes: Impaired self-consistency, wavering between personal values (independence) and external evaluations
Inner conflict triggering Anxiety and Decreased motivation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming others will see oneself as a 'lonely person' without direct evidence
After socializing, tends to speculate about the other's negative evaluation (mind reading)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned about image when talking about hobbies, careful with words to avoid being judged
Repeatedly seeking reassurance from friends to ease uncertainty

exception_events.target_problem: When talking about solo hiking with others or in social situations, Wang Jie usually worries about being labeled a 'lonely person', thus developing Anxiety and avoiding further communication.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one hike, an elderly couple praised his gear and asked him for route advice; he engaged actively and felt respected and recognized, without yet falling into worries about 'being judged'.
exception_events.reason: Different support/situation: the other party was friendly and actively asked for advice; different understanding: focusing on the present interaction and one's own abilities; different approach: giving advice based on experience, receiving positive feedback, boosting confidence.

positive_force: Valuing independence and Freedom, with intrinsic motivation for hiking
Has actual hiking experience and knowledge, can provide value in interactions
Able to do reality testing and identify positive evidence (such as recalling friendly interactions)
Willing to seek help and try new methods (such as recording positive experiences)
Having some Social support (friends and family can provide Listening)
negative_force: Overly relies on external evaluation to confirm self-worth (seeking external validation)
Tendency to mind-read and predict the future, exaggerating potential negative evaluations
Mental filtering of negative cues; ignores positive experiences
Avoidance behaviors (fewer solo outings, avoiding discussion), relieving Anxiety short-term but maintaining the problem
Rumination causing Sleep disturbed, further weakening emotion regulation ability

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and avoidance in solo-hiking-related situations, with frequent reassurance-seeking from others
antecedent: When talking about hiking with others
After recalling others' comments about 'solo hikers being very lonely'
When ruminating alone after social interactions end
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing 'acting alone = being seen as lonely / not accepted' as a rule, and strongly binding self-worth to others' evaluations, leading to catastrophic Anticipation of negative evaluations.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluations to temporarily lower Anxiety, and gaining short-term security and recognition through reassurance-seeking
target_behavior.consequence: Declining motivation and enjoyment in hiking, Avoids socializing and talking about the hobby, Relationship tension, Sleep disturbed, Continuing self-doubt and reinforcing the Anxiety cycle
